newsitem.title: UK: GKN to expand in aerospace/defence - paper.
newsitem.headline: GKN to expand in aerospace/defence - paper.

text.p: UK engineering giant GKN Plc is seeking to expand its aerospace and defence businesses in an effort to lift its profile in the North American and Asia regions, the Financial Times weekend edition said.

The report said the group is looking for acquisitions in the United States in the aircraft components sector as well as examining opportunities for helicopter joint ventures in Asia and the Pacific Rim.
The FT said that some industry players believe that the group could be looking at making a bid for Rohr, the Californian engine-casings maker.

But GKN refused to comment on this. The FT quoted CK Chow, GKN's chief executive, explaining that the group hoped to exploit opportunities arising out of the consolidation of the European defence industry.
"Consolidation is inevitable in the European armoured vehicle sector and we would like to pro-actively lead that effort," said Chow.
The group has around 470 million in free cash.
